task_description: Investigate and resolve 400 Bad Request error when submitting Request Revisions from Proponents in Capstone 1 title proposal deliberation.
root_causes: Strict titleStatus check in project.service.js:rejectTitle: only project.titleStatus === SUBMITTED was permitted, throwing 400 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION when projects were in revision_required, draft, approved, or approved_with_revision (e.g. project 6abd3d0745027cf1c8fee54d in revision_required).
rejectTitle lacked proposalId resolution and metadata status synchronization, preventing individual proposal tracking in titleProposalMetadata.

Client error toast in Capstone1CollapsibleSections.jsx extracted err?.response?.data?.message instead of err?.response?.data?.error?.message, falling back to raw Axios string 'Request failed with status code 400'.

modifications.summary: Expanded allowed rejectTitle pre-revision statuses to include SUBMITTED, DRAFT, APPROVED, APPROVED_WITH_REVISION, REVISION_REQUIRED, and PENDING_MODIFICATION. Added resilient proposalId resolution across ObjectIds, titles, and array indices, marking targeted proposal as 'rejected' in titleProposalMetadata.
Added optional proposalId: z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).optional() to rejectTitleSchema.
Updated useRejectTitle to pass proposalId to projectService.rejectTitle.
Passed proposalId: selectedProposalIndex to rejectTitleMutation.mutateAsync and enhanced error toast extraction to check err?.response?.data?.error?.message.
Added unit tests verifying rejectTitle transitions from SUBMITTED, DRAFT, APPROVED, and REVISION_REQUIRED statuses.
Added unit test asserting instructor can submit revision request with remarks and proposalId.
